content: Mer yogasaar be sogo, we dule-isganaye
Jesús sogdebalid: “Mer yogsaar be sogo, we-dule, dule-isganaye, adi, melle deyob begi soglemogagar.
Ar dulemargi be sogsadyobi, begi soglemogoed, degine, dulemarga be igar-mesisadyobi, bega igar-megnonimogoed.
”¿Ar ibiga be-gwenad-ibyagi durgan-maid magar be dake? Ar be-ibya-yabardi suar-maiddi aku be daked.
¿Ar igi be-gwenadgardi be sogoe: ‘Be-ibya-yaba durgan-maid an bega onogweloye?’ Ar be-ibya-yabardi suar-maiddi aku be daked.
”¡Ar bemar wagar-darbomaladid! Suar be-ibya-yaba-maid-inse be onoge, geb agi nabir be atakoed. Ar deyob geb be be-gwenad-ibya-yaba-durgan-maid onogoed.

”Mer be ibmar-nuegan-islidikmalad achumarga ukmar. Ar abakalegi begi aibinnarmalale, be-san ichimakarmalale. Degine, dimmurgiid-e-akwa-yeerdaklemalad mer be sinmarga mimar, ar abakalegi egi dii-dii annaarmalale.”
Bab-Dummadse ibmar-egisleged
Jesús sogdebalid: “Be Bab-Dummadse ibmar egismar, ar Bab-Dummad bemarga ukoed. Be Bab-Dummadgi ibmar amimar, be amimaloed. Be Bab-Dummadse gole, bega Bab-Dummad yawagak egaoed.
”Ar dule ibmar-bela-egiser, ibmar nikued. Ar dule ibmar-amier, ibmar amioed. Ar dule yawagakgi-dulese-golele, ega yawagak egalegoed.
”¿Ar doa-dule, e-mimmi ese madu-egichialile, ega akwa ukode?
¿Ar ua ese egichiardibe, ega naibe ukode? Gege uked.
Ar bemarde dule-isgana-gumar-inigwele, degite, be-mimmiganga ibmar-nuegan ukmalad. Ar be-Bab-nibneggi-maid-bulesunna, ¿dulemar-ese-ibmar-egismaladga ibmar-nuegan ukosur be insade? Ukergebed.
”Degisoggu, dulemar igi bega ibmar-imakbi be abege, deyob ega be imakmodo. Ar weyob Moisés Igar-Mesisad, degi, weyob Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad sogsamogad.”
Yawagak-osogwad
Jesús sogdebalid: “Yawagak-yaa-osogwadba be dogmar. Ar yawagak-yaa-dummaddi, e-igar mata-bipisulid. A-igardi, yoggued-negse dulemar-semaid, degine, bukidar agi dulemar bur dogmalad.
”Ar burba-geg-bergued-nikadsedi yawagak-yaa-osogwadba, degine, igar-warakwagwadba dogleged. Dulemar ichee a-yawagak amimalad.”
Dule, e-daedgi mag be dakmaloed
Jesús sogdebalid: “Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-sunnadsurmaladgi nue salakarmar. Ar amar yamo sibad-wawaadyob nonimaloed. Ar e-ulubgindi, achu-burburudyob sabsur-damalad-dulemalad.
”A-dulemar e-daedgi be dakmaloed. ¿Ar uvaʼde, iko-sapigi-sanmaksi? ¿Ar higoʼde, iko-sapigi welesi? Degisulid.
Ar deyobdo. Sapi-nuegana, e-durba nueganbi sanmaked. Ar sapi-isganadi, e-durba-sanmaked isganabimogad.
Ar sapi-nuedi geg e-durba isgana sanmaked. Degine, sapi-isgana, geg e-durba nued sanmakmogad.
”Ar sapimar e-durba nued sanmaksulile, olalegodo, soogi ogumaklegodo.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-sunnadsurmalad e-daedgi mag be dakmaloed.”
Bab-negse bela dulemar dogosulid
Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar bela dulemar anga ‘Dummadye, Dummadye’ sogedba, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse gwen dogosulid. Unnila, dulemar an-Bab-nibneggi-maid-sogedba ibmar-saedi nibneggi dogmaloed.
”Bukidar a-ibagangi anga sogdamaloed. ‘Dummad, ¿ar anmarde be-nuggi sunmaksasursi? ¿Ar anmarde be-nuggi bukidar niamar-onosmarsursi? ¿Ar anmarde be-nuggine bukidar ibmar-dakledisurmalad imaksasursi?’
Geb degi an abin-sogoed: ‘Aku an be-dake. Angi be bangumar. Bemar, unnila ibmar-isgana-saedginbi arbadimalad.’ ”
Dule-binsaed-nikadaed, degi, dule-binsaedsulidaed
Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar doa-dule we-an-sunmaked itosale, degine, eba daele, we-dule, dule-binsaed-nikadaed na e-neg akwa-birgi-sobsayobidid.
Dii-wiargu, diwarmar noalid, burwamar binnasur gollalid. Bela-bela a-neggi signonigu, a-neg gwen aimukussulid, ar ade, neg akwa-birgi sobar siid.
”Degine, ar doa-dule we-an-sunmaked itosale, degite, eba ibmar-imaksasulile, we-dule, dule-binsaedsulid na e-neg ukub-birgi-sobsayobidid.
Dii-wiargu, diwarmar noalid, burwamar binnasur gollalid. Bela-bela a-neggi signonigu, e-neg ayarided, a-neg nue-dummad bisgenonikid.”
Ar Jesús weyob-ibmar-sogsad-sorba, dulemar Jesús-weyob-e-ibmar-odurdaked geger daksa gusmalad.
Ar ade, Jesús e-ibmar-odurdakedi, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar-odurdakeyob odurdaksulid. Edi na gangued-nika odurdaked.
